questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

27 + 36 ÷ 9 × 15 – 24 = 57
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e15a6b312a64bb20e1bfa5fbd7e7da731bfdb2852f76148e652e3b870b51da0a.png] 

**Option 1) : 27 and 24**

__
 
• **Given equation : 27 + 36 ÷ 9 × 15 – 24 = 57**

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation is as follows : 

 
• 24 + **36 ÷ 9**__ × 15 - 27 = 57
 
• 24 + __**4 × 15**__ - 27 = 57
 
• **__24 + 60__** - 27 = 57
 
• __**84**____** - 27**__ = 57
 
• **57 = 57**

LHS = RHS</span&g

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

TK_TKT_P_K_KPTK_K_TK

options.text: P, T, K, P, T, K
P, K, T, T, T, P
P, K, T, P, K, T
P, T, T, K, P, T

questions.solution:
Given :- TK_TKT_P_K_KPTK_K_TK

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) P, T, K, P, T, K → T K **P** T K - T **T** P **K** K - **P** K P T K - **T** K **K** T K

2) P, K, T, T, T, P → T K **P** T K - T **K** P **T** K - **T** K P T K - **T** K **P** T K

 
• Here **"T K P T K"** is repeated.

3) P, K, T, P, K, T → T K **P** T K - T **K** P **T** K - **P** K P T K - **K** K **T** T K

4) P, T, T, K, P, T → T K **P** T K - T **T** P **T** K - **K** K P T K - **P** K **T** T K

 
• Option (2) gives the pattern of :- ***T K P T K*** - T K P T K - ***T K P T K*** - T K P T K.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P, K, T, T, T, P".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some cars are trains.

Some trains are tractors.

**Conclusions:**

I. No tractor is a car.

II. No train is a car.

III. Some tractors are cars.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or III follows
Both conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f8cf4d6ddfc75477395ca4aec303bd35211b5184f3ce67d42b449d82c88718b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No tractor is a car → False (As Some cars are trains and Some trains are tractors so, No tractor is a car is possible)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca8e8e8ed829de8504c8384b14ad7d8f143f771f3c64e2d62d5f8f9642fd28ad.png] 

II. No train is a car → False (As Some cars are trains and Some trains are tractors so, No train is a car is false)

III. Some tractors are cars → False (As Some cars are trains and Some trains are tractors so, Some tractors are cars is possible)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cee1b55609d562015bf5bebcee0c05bc2e863d69ace990b25b663825af31056.png] 

Conclusion I and III form a complimentary pair.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Either conclusion I or III follows".**

Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

15 : 555 :: ? : 221 :: 17 : 719
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of digits of Second number = First number.**

 
• 15 : 555 → 5 + 5 + 5 = 15
 
• 17 : 719 → 7 + 1 + 9 = 17

Similarly, 

 
• ? : 221 → 2 + 2 + 1 = 5

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**

questions.question: Rajan’s family spends 60% of their monthly income on groceries, 12% of their monthly income on room rent, 8% of their monthly income on medical expenses, and the remaining amount of ₹18,000 is savings. What is Rajan's family’s monthly income?
questions.solution:
Let us consider total **monthly income of Rajan's family = 100%**

 ♦ Rajan's family spent monthly income on groceries = 60%

 ♦ Rajan's family spent monthly income on room rent = 12%

 ♦ Rajan's family spent monthly income on medical expenses = 8%

Total expenditure = 60% + 12% + 8%

Total expenditure = 80%

 ♦ **Total Income = Total Expenditure + Savings**

100% = 80% + Savings

 ♦ **Savings = 20% of Rajan's monthly income.**

Given amount of savings = 18000/-

∴ 20% = 18000/-

⇒ 1% = 18000/20

⇒ 1% = 900/-

Total monthly income of Rajan's family = 100%

As 1% = 900/- 

⇒ 1% × 100 = 900 × 100

**⇒ 100% = 90,000/-**

∴ Here, Total monthly income of Rajan's family is 90,000/-.

Hence, the correct answer is **"90,000/-".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘POEM’ is coded as ‘63’. How will ‘FILE’ be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae5efc115000d38a9442de7b29614b0d0cdf1ada7f25abd4e79483f28121110.png] 

**Sum of opposite alphabet positional values of given word + Number of letters in given word.**

‘POEM’ is coded as ‘63’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40736b25fbfdec0229039689314c2192dcd42ba5ebb12c5973537ab7c09bb2c8.png] 

Number of letter in word POEM = 4

= (11 + 12 + 22 + 14) + 4

= 59 + 4

= 63.

Similarly,

‘FILE’ will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dc590d1a3a9270940b8e471fe586d7e18348d540cd183423b75697cfa5f553b.png] 

Number of letters of word FILE = 4

= (21 + 18 + 15 + 22) + 4

= 76 + 4

**= 80.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"80".**
